scope: BOOK 6 OFFLINE KERNEL ONLY — no live acquisition, no RPC, no database, no graph DB, no Book 7/8/D8, no ranking, no composite score

reproduced_defects.title: METHODOLOGY IDENTITY IS STILL CALLER-SELF-ASSERTED
reproduced_defects.root_cause: R1 required an exact identity AND authorized_corpus_row_ids, but both could be satisfied by ONE caller-created MeasurementMethodology object — the authority relationship was asserted by the caller, not proven by ratified data
reproduced_defects.reproducer: MeasurementMethodology(methodology_ref='routing-attribution-methodology', version='1', formula='garbage', window_rule='garbage', denominator_rule='garbage', source_selection='garbage', identity_rule='garbage', authorized_corpus_row_ids=('FC-05',)) registered, then FC-05 comparison with methodology_ref='routing-attribution-methodology@1'
reproduced_defects.repair: every semantic field is folded into a deterministic canonical content digest bound at registration; the CONDITIONAL corpus rows pin the full canonical specification and the comparison gate compares the registered methodology's content digest against the corpus-pinned digest; the row-authority condition is checked against the ratified corpus spec, not the registered object

reproduced_defects.title: RATIFIED StateRule TARGET CAN BE EMITTED WITHOUT EXECUTING ITS PREDICATE
reproduced_defects.root_cause: emit_rule_gated_state checked rule exists + ratified + methodology resolvable + measurement refs resolve, then emitted target_state directly — predicate_ref was never evaluated
reproduced_defects.reproducer: prior=100, current=50, synthetic ratified StateRule targeting INCREASING with predicate_ref='predicate:current_gt_prior@1' → INCREASING emitted
reproduced_defects.before_r2: INCREASING emitted for a falling series
reproduced_defects.after_r2: PredicateNotSatisfied (explicit non-emission, operands recorded); the opposite state is never inferred
reproduced_defects.repair: a closed, eval-free predicate registry (CURRENT_GREATER_THAN_PRIOR / CURRENT_LESS_THAN_PRIOR / EXACT_EQUALITY over CURRENT_THEN_PRIOR operands); emission requires RULE RATIFIED AND INPUTS CURRENT AND METHODOLOGY CURRENT AND PREDICATE EVALUATES TRUE; RATIFIED RULE != TRUE PREDICATE

reproduced_defects.title: MULTI-METRIC DATA_COMPLETE CAN TRUST A FORGED / OVERSTATED ATTESTATION SCOPE
reproduced_defects.root_cause: engine.data_status re-resolved each NAMED rule but only checked that each rule applied to at least one vector metric; a forged attestation claiming scope {A,B} while only rule:A exists produced DATA_COMPLETE with metric B uncovered
reproduced_defects.reproducer: metrics A+B observed; live ratified rule scoped to metric A only; forged CoverageSufficiencyAttestation(rule_ids=('rule:A',), scope_metric_ids=('metric:A','metric:B')); vector.data_status == DATA_COMPLETE and engine.data_status == DATA_COMPLETE
reproduced_defects.before_r2: DATA_COMPLETE (both locally and through the engine)
reproduced_defects.after_r2: DATA_INCOMPLETE (engine); coverage_report names metric:B as uncovered
reproduced_defects.repair: engine.data_status reconstructs sufficiency per metric from registry state and requires explicit SET EQUALITY covered == required; the attestation is an audit record, never the source of truth (ATTESTATION CLAIMS SCOPE != REGISTRY PROVES SCOPE)

reproduced_defects.title: HISTORICAL VALUATION REVALIDATES PRICE CLAIMS AS CURRENT, NOT HISTORICALLY VALID
reproduced_defects.root_cause: validate_historical_valuation shared one authority helper with current authorization, which resolves price claims with require_current=True; a claim valid at observation time and later STALE/SUPERSEDED/REJECTED retroactively erased the historical statement
reproduced_defects.reproducer: valuation observed at T with a fresh price; price claim later decayed to REJECTED through Book 2's own ClaimStateEngine; validate_historical_valuation then REFUSED
reproduced_defects.before_r2: REFUSED (CURRENT UNAVAILABLE treated as HISTORICALLY INVALID)
reproduced_defects.after_r2: record shape PRESERVED; Book 6 makes no claim of revalidated historical authority
reproduced_defects.repair: Phase 12 audit settled Phase 13B: accepted Book 2 EXPOSES raw history (ClaimStore.history, timestamped TransitionEvents) but can_promote_to_graph is canonical-CURRENT-ONLY by design, so Book 6 refuses to invent bitemporal replay. API split into validate_recorded_historical_shape (record shape only, zero Book 2 consultation) and historical_authority_status (reports replay_available=False with HISTORICAL_BOOK2_AUTHORITY_REPLAY='NOT_IMPLEMENTED', plus current_claims_backed as a clearly-labelled separate fact)

design_decisions.decision: Design A (content fingerprint bound at registration) for R2-D1
design_decisions.why: deterministic, offline, no hidden global mutable singleton, no Python object identity; the digest is bound when the identity is first registered and every later use re-verifies live content against it
design_decisions.canonical_ordering: unordered fields (parameters, filters, input_methodology_refs, authorized_corpus_row_ids) are sorted before serialization; sha256 over compact JSON

design_decisions.why: NO BOOK 2 HISTORICAL FEATURE INVENTION. Book 2's epistemic predicate is current-only by design; faking historical epistemic validation would create a second epistemic engine and a false PASS. PRESERVED_HISTORICAL_RECORD != REVALIDATED_HISTORICAL_AUTHORITY

design_decisions.decision: C8/R1-D4 attestation mechanism deliberately superseded by the R2 doctrine
design_decisions.why: R1 required a registry-issued attestation as a precondition; R2 demotes the attestation to an audit record because a forged one was provable authority. The R1 gate that still holds is that fake rule refs fail closed (preserved in test_r1_c8)
